verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official first-party MCP server that gives AI agents tools to work with the Stripe API, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. The pack never shows that this server exposes Stripe Identity resources such as verification sessions, so its coverage of this product is unproven. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server exposes Identity-specific tools (e.g. creating or retrieving verification sessions), setup and auth documentation for connecting an agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
